description: Derived, pre-registered, stratified eval dataset manifest (EVAL-01). WiCE rows are vendored under wice-vendored/ (ODC-BY/MIT, the only commit-safe corpus). AVeriTeC (CC-BY-NC) and LLM-AggreFact (CC-BY-ND) are FETCH-ONLY: this manifest carries only their IDs + remapped labels + pinned revision + sha256, never the raw corpus text (D-04 license compliance). The remap target is the FROZEN verdict enum unrefuted|refuted.

task6_run_config.note: Task-6 run-config PIN (additive; the zero-votes window is still open -- no Stage-1 vote has been cast). The three under-specified parameters fixed BEFORE the screen. nControls is a free draw-size (N is frozen post-screen, so a generous draw is not result-shopping); the two F5 tolerances adopt the frozen code-defaults. NONE of these alters a RE-PLAN-7/8 key or a frozen primitive.
task6_run_config.nControls_justification: The TRAP arm is the binding constraint -- it is the OOF screen's active drop target (lower retention). nControls=40 demands the lowest trap retention r_t>=0.60 of any option while controls still clear r_c>=0.77; best pessimistic-corner joint margin; the largest trap pool stabilizes the F5 stats. 60 risks failing the trap floor under a culling screen; 50 is an unconfirmed interpolation.
task6_run_config.covariateOverlapTolerance_justification: The frozen code-default (assembleStage1Traps/assembleWiceTraps). A post-screen VOID guard (trap/control claim-length overlap), not a tuning knob.
task6_run_config.subjectDifficultyMaxCatchRate_justificat: The frozen code-default. A symmetric midpoint: a held-out-Claude reference catching > 50% of the retained traps voids the set as too easy (VOID-difficulty).
task6_run_config.partition_rule: controlSeeds = supported.slice(len - nControls) (the trailing nControls Supported AVeriTeC seeds, ascending claim_id); trapSeeds = the remaining qualifying Supported seeds. nControls reserves trailing seeds FROM the shared trap pool (a seed used as a trap is never reused as a control). Verified against assembleStage1Traps.
task6_run_config.feasibility_at_40: Pre-screen pools (real assemblers, accept-all stubs): AVeriTeC 42 traps + 20 controls; WiCE (F6 cluster-collapsed) 18 traps + 11 controls -> combined ~60 traps (>=36) + ~31 controls (>=24). Reachable with margin; the control arm is the tighter post-screen constraint.

averitec_ncontrols_superseded_by_replan9.note: RE-PLAN-9 supersedes the nControls=40 pin (9b16c60) -- AVeriTeC nControls=0 (ALL AVeriTeC seeds are traps); controls come from the entailment-native FEVER+VitaminC source (NOT reserved AVeriTeC native seeds). The zero-votes window is STILL OPEN (the gold VOIDed at the gold-build BEFORE any subject vote), so this is pre-registration-clean, NOT result-shopping. The original nControls=40 pin + nControls_justification above are PRESERVED + annotated SUPERSEDED, never deleted. The trigger: AVeriTeC 'Supported' is an aggregate human judgment over the full evidence base, NOT strict excerpt-entailment, so native AVeriTeC controls drop under the strict OOF screen (~7 << N_CTRL_FLOOR 24; 19-04-T-SPEND-1-OUTCOME.md). The assembler CODE is unchanged (nControls=0 is the existing trap-only path).

stage1_pre_registration.note: Pre-registered in the ZERO-VOTES window BEFORE any Stage-1 vote (anti result-shopping, T-19-15). The construct-validity-corrected offline gating read (19-04-REPLAN-DECISION-4, AMENDING -3 / -2; UNANIMOUS cross-family board, 5/5, OPTION A): ONE offline CLOSED-BOOK JUDGMENT-difficulty stratum (evidence-absent); buried is DROPPED (construct-invalid offline, D-RP4-1: the synthetic disconfirmer flag is text-unverified; the count-vs-rank predicate error D-RP4-2 mis-classified all 62 seeds as buried) and date-sensitive DEFERRED to Phase-20 live (its post-cutoff-leak arm is unobservable offline) -- both deferred to the Phase-20 live shadow. The offline gate measures CLOSED-BOOK JUDGMENT (resist-uphold-on-absence), NOT retrieval orchestration (which is not cleanly + leak-safely measurable offline and defers to the Phase-20 live operational shadow). EVAL_THRESHOLDS numbers are byte-unchanged.
stage1_pre_registration.url_date_rule_note: The byte-locked strict path-only RegExp source the KS-enrichment layer (eval/lz-eval-trap-assembler.mjs extractUrlDate) uses; range-checked through the FROZEN safeParse. An archive-wrapped URL yields the INNER publication date (the 14-digit wrapper timestamp has no slash separators); a no-match / out-of-range / implausibly-future date returns null (fail closed, DROP only, never leak). The aggregate anti-drift test asserts this string equals URL_DATE_RULE.source byte-for-byte.
stage1_pre_registration.seed_selection: Deterministic: ALL qualifying Supported AVeriTeC-dev seeds by ASCENDING claim_id (no hand-picking). A seed is qualifying iff its claim_date normalizes (single-digit-day zero-pad at the assembly layer; the FROZEN parseAvtDate stays frozen and still throws on a raw single-digit day) AND >= 5 strictly-pre-cutoff dated docs survive the frozen dateFilter.
stage1_pre_registration.scoring_reconciliation: The SCORED quantity is the MODEL voter's free-text vote.verdict over the date-filtered KS text (persisted in {unrefuted,refuted}, read by countFalseUpholds). searchAndStop's flag-driven mechanical verdict enum {judge-result,'refuted-default','insufficient'} is the TRACE + the mechanical minimums ONLY and NEVER overrides the recorded vote; the decisive/disconfirmer/verdict flags drive ONLY searchAndStop's trace + classifySeed's stratum assignment (T-19-19).
stage1_pre_registration.no_abstention_rule: The offline-read dispatch prompt REQUIRES a definite refuted/unrefuted verdict (the gating read measures the BINARY false-uphold). A null/abstain/unparseable vote is NOT persisted (persistVote rejects non-{unrefuted,refuted}) and is RE-CAST until a definite vote lands, so each seat's pool completes only with definite votes and readDelta proceeds only at a complete exactly-nPooled pool.
stage1_pre_registration.survivor_rule: >= 5 strictly-pre-cutoff dated surviving docs per seed (else the seed is excluded -- min-not-met must not silently change the trap); >= 3 distinct surviving claims per stratum (so nPooled >= reliableTrials=15 at k=5).
stage1_pre_registration.cutoff_rule: STRICT cutoff -- NO date-shift, NO claimDate-1 imputation (rejected by all three reviewers). Undated + same-day (== claimDate) docs are DROPPED by the strict `<` in the frozen dateFilter.
stage1_pre_registration.k_to_1_reduction_rule: The dispatch persists k votes/claim keyed seat-uid-k; readDelta consumes ONE pooled record/claim keyed by the claim uid (the F3/F4 realized-count guard). The reduction is reducePooledVerdict (the dispatch Workflow SHARED block, Task 2). The chosen false-uphold-over-k rule is ANY-UPHOLD (stated explicitly, locked before any vote): a claim's pooled verdict is a FALSE-UPHOLD (unrefuted on a refuted-gold trap) if ANY of its k votes upholds -- NOT majority. Rationale: a single silent uphold-on-absence is exactly the failure the gate hunts; the conservative any-uphold rule mirrors the shipped pipeline tally's downgrade-not-delete posture (I2, 19-04-REPLAN-DECISION-3).
stage1_pre_registration.construct_scope_boundary: The offline gate measures CLOSED-BOOK JUDGMENT (resist-uphold-on-absence) over an orchestrator-supplied date-window evidence packet, NOT retrieval orchestration. A closed-book PASS tests JUDGMENT difficulty, NOT query-formulation / search-depth / premature-stop. Retrieval is NOT cleanly + leak-safely measurable offline (the frozen staticKsAdapter ignores the query; a leak-safe model-driven offline retrieval would need a net-new ranked top-k index over a thin median-5 corpus -> poor ROI). Retrieval DEFERS to the Phase-20 LIVE operational shadow (shadow -> canary -> tier-1; ROADMAP SC-6), which is OPERATIONAL, not a clean leak-controlled gold-known retrieval eval -- so retrieval is NEVER silently assumed-covered and a closed-book PASS NEVER certifies retrieval (19-04-REPLAN-DECISION-3 item 4).
stage1_pre_registration.buried_dropped_rule: buried is DROPPED ENTIRELY from the offline gate (construct-invalid offline, RE-PLAN-4 D-RP4-1; NOT auto-gated, NOT auto-dropped at run time -- removed from the strata definition). evidence-absent is the SOLE offline arm (resist-uphold-on-absence). WHY: the synthetic disconfirmer=true flag on an arbitrary deep surviving doc is TEXT-UNVERIFIED -- the doc's text almost never refutes the SPECIFIC mutated overreach, so a blind probe would reject most synthetic-buried; it measures a FAKE construct. Deep-refuter detection is retrieval-adjacent / context-attention, deferred to the Phase-20 live shadow. Dropping buried does NOT materially weaken the gate (evidence-absent is the one genuinely-new arm). The SINGLE evidence-absent stratum FAILS CLOSED below the floor (degenerate corpus / a below-floor RETAINED set after the gold-blind probe drops = the documented VOID).
stage1_pre_registration.gold_blind_validity_probe: The MANDATORY mitigation (load-bearing -- FATAL if omitted; board guardrails 1+2+4+6). Before any verify-vote, screen every candidate evidence-absent packet with a PRE-REGISTERED, GOLD-BLIND model judge (NO AVeriTeC label, NO mutation knowledge). It reads ONLY the date-filtered surviving SUPPORTING docs + the mutated OVERREACH claim and answers 'do these docs explicitly state OR directly entail the one-step OVERREACH, or only the weaker ORIGINAL Supported claim?'. DISQUALIFY (drop; REPORT the count in attrition.probeDropped, never silently absorb) any packet where the survivors plausibly entail/license the overreach (there unrefuted is a legitimate read and gold=refuted is indefensible -- the defect that killed buried). RETAIN as valid gold=refuted ONLY packets whose survivors support the ORIGINAL claim but do NOT entail the overreach (resist-uphold-on-absence). The probe is GOLD-BLIND so it does NOT bootstrap the gold it validates (else it breaks closed-book). The retained-gold floor is >= perStratumFloor (3); the RETAINED set < floor AFTER the probe drops = a documented VOID (the corpus cannot honestly build the PRIMARY arm). NEVER tune the probe threshold toward a desired N (result-shopping) -- the floor is load-bearing, not a knob (board guardrail 5, D-RP4-3). The assembler consumes it via the injected validityProbe({trap, enrichedKs, stratum, decisiveRank}) at SCREEN 2.
stage1_pre_registration.count_vs_rank_correction: The count-vs-rank predicate error (D-RP4-2, the principled basis for the RE-PLAN-4 amendment) + the synthetic-disconfirmer finding (D-RP4-1). The RE-PLAN-3 assembler assigned the stratum by isBuried = (INDEX of the deepest surviving doc in the 0..99 KS list >= BURIED_RANK_FLOOR=20), conflating survivor COUNT (median 5) with survivor RANK/position (0..99). The ~8.6% dated survivors scatter across positions 0..99 so the DEEPEST survivor index is almost always >= 20 (measured 97/97/96/80/76) -> ALL 62 qualifying seeds classified buried, ZERO evidence-absent -> the assembler HARD-THREW on the PRIMARY floor and the calibrator could not run. The committed RE-PLAN-3 'rank-20 burial is impossible at median-5' claim is empirically FALSE. This is the SECOND construct defect on this instrument (C1 -- the dispatch object/text return -- was first). Re-pre-registration timing guardrail: this amendment is SOUND in the ZERO-VOTES window (no votes -> no result to shop); the corrected spec locks BEFORE any vote (board guardrail 1).
stage1_pre_registration.no_mcp_build_decision: The offline gate is CLOSED-BOOK judgment (Option A); the dev MCP + a NET-NEW ranked-retrieval index (Option B) is NOT built -- bounded downside (it gates only an OFF-by-default flag; Sonnet ships regardless) + a thin/low-fidelity median-5 corpus + redundancy with the Phase-20 live pilot make the index build poor ROI (three independent consult rounds converged; 19-04-REPLAN-DECISION-3). A clean offline retrieval gate is a CONDITIONAL follow-on (separately pre-registered; NOT in 19-04/19-05), triggered only if evidence-absent discriminates AND the owner signs off AND a >= 100-doc leak-safe trap set proves feasible.
stage1_pre_registration.scope_limit_haiku_on: A closed-book PASS does NOT certify retrieval; Haiku stays OFF pending live evidence. Turning the Haiku-first flag ON requires BOTH (a) an offline closed-book PASS on evidence-absent (the strata must DISCRIMINATE -- a non-saturated calibrator) AND (b) live shadow -> canary operational evidence on retrieval within a pre-committed tolerance of Sonnet. On a closed-book PASS ALONE the flag STAYS OFF, with retrieval as the NAMED pre-registered precondition for any future flip (EVAL-03 raise-to-user). OFF-by-default + pre-committed rollback throughout.

no_refuter_ranks.note: RE-PLAN-4: there are NO decisive/disconfirmer ranks offline -- buried is DROPPED, so the assembler attaches NO refuter flag (decisiveRank=-1, disconfirmerRank=-1). The evidence-absent packet is the date-filtered ORIGINAL supporting docs (plausible supporting text, no in-corpus refuter). The EXAMPLE evidence-absent rows below (averitec-dev-0006/0007) are seed claim_ids; the mutated prose + enriched KS live in the gitignored run artifact under eval/.cache/ (recipe-not-text), never the committed manifest (no NC text).

stage1_pre_registration.positive_controls: RE-PLAN-5 Finding 1 (mandatory power/plumbing check). With EVERY retained trap gold=refuted, a 0-false-uphold result is CONFOUNDED -- observationally identical to a DEGENERATE ALWAYS-REFUTE prior (a voter that refutes everything on thin evidence scores a perfect 0 for the WRONG reason and measures nothing). The assembler interleaves gold=unrefuted POSITIVE CONTROLS -- native UNMUTATED AVeriTeC-Supported seeds whose date-filtered survivors GENUINELY ENTAIL the claim (the inverse of the trap screen: ALL probes agree entails=true; NO mutateOverreach) -- indistinguishable to the voter. The voter SHOULD vote unrefuted on them; if Sonnet REFUTES them too -> ALWAYS-REFUTE-ARTIFACT -> VOID/uninterpretable, NOT a clean saturation. The positive-control floor is >= 3 (its OWN floor, INDEPENDENT of the evidence-absent trap floor; below = VOID-on-control-floor -- the read cannot prove the voter CAN uphold). scorePositiveControls reads ONLY 'unrefuted'-gold records and FAILS CLOSED on a 'refuted'-gold record in the control voteDir (W-2). The tolerance is ZERO: ANY control refute voids the saturation read.
stage1_pre_registration.out_of_family_probe_consensus: RE-PLAN-5 Finding 2 (mandatory, all-agree-retain; the highest-leverage de-confounder). The in-family gold-blind probe is SAME-FAMILY with the voter (Opus GENERATEs, Opus PROBEs, Sonnet VOTES) and is DEMONSTRABLY TOO LENIENT -- PROVEN on pilot seed 75 (overreach 'income DOUBLED'; survivors '$200K -> millions' EXCEED 2x, so the survivors plausibly ENTAIL 'doubled'; the in-family probe RETAINED it ONLY by a strict-literal 'no explicit 2x ratio' reading; a Sonnet voter reading it loosely would CORRECTLY vote unrefuted -> a FAKE false-uphold, the T-19-17 defect). MANDATORY: a SECOND, OUT-OF-FAMILY gold-blind probe pass (GPT-5.5 + Gemini) via 'cat <prompt> | copilot --model {gpt-5.5|gemini-3.1-pro-preview} --effort high' (NO -p, NO --allow-all-tools; output captured to gitignored eval/.cache/). RETAIN a TRAP packet only if ALL probes agree entails=false; RETAIN a CONTROL only if ALL agree entails=true; ANY split DISQUALIFIES (drop, REPORT the count in attrition.probeDropped + probeSplitDropped). OUT-OF-FAMILY GENERATE is DEFERRED with rationale (board guardrail 7): generation is gold-aware and inspection already found real one-step overreaches; the bigger same-family risk is the PROBE, which IS moved out-of-family; out-of-family generate is a secondary nice-to-have.
stage1_pre_registration.probe_strictness_rubric: RE-PLAN-5 (pre-registered BEFORE any vote). A packet whose survivors support MORE than the overreach (e.g. the survivors entail >2x when the overreach says 'doubled') is DISQUALIFIED -- the survivors ENTAIL the overreach, so gold=refuted is indefensible there. RETAIN ONLY packets whose survivors support the ORIGINAL claim STRICTLY but do NOT entail the overreach. The seed-75 example ('income DOUBLED'; survivors '$200K -> millions' EXCEED 2x) is the canonical DISQUALIFY case.
stage1_pre_registration.k_and_seat_diversity: RE-PLAN-5 (board UNANIMOUS-2; picked ONCE here). Raise k above the MIN_K=5 floor to k=9 (zone 9-11; k is AT-OR-ABOVE the frozen MIN_K floor, NOT a threshold change -- the DISPATCH DEFAULT becomes 9, kFloorAtLeast still admits any explicit k>=MIN_K). Under any-uphold each extra vote is one more independent opportunity to expose a false-uphold -> strictly MORE conservative for a saturation/accept-the-null gate; diminishing returns past ~11. The extra k is spent on SEAT DIVERSITY across distinct attack-modes (the ATTACK_MODES rotation: factual-contradiction / scope-causality-overclaim / source-provenance / absence-of-evidence / quantifier-scope / causality-certainty / contradiction-vs-support), NOT identical re-draws. k is chosen ONCE here -- re-choosing after seeing Stage-1 would be result-shopping.
stage1_pre_registration.non_zero_decision_rule: RE-PLAN-5 Finding 3 (pre-registered BEFORE vote 1; the engine returns only saturated-vs-below-ceiling and does NOT fix what '1 false-uphold over N' MEANS). EXACT wording: 'A Sonnet false-uphold over the retained N counts as a GENUINE below-ceiling PROCEED signal ONLY IF (i) the packet survived the ALL-PROBES-AGREE consensus (in-family Opus + GPT-5.5 + Gemini all said entails=false), (ii) the per-vote search trace is min-MET (minQueries+minDocs satisfied) and stop_reason is exhausted or decisive-evidence (NEVER min-not-met / truncated / quota-killed), and (iii) the positive controls were UPHELD (not an always-refute artifact). A false-uphold failing (i)/(ii) is an ARTIFACT-to-investigate (void/redo that vote), never a below-ceiling PROCEED. 0 false-upholds with positive-controls UPHELD on clean traces is a LEGITIMATE evidence-justified SATURATED->VOID; 0 false-upholds with positive-controls REFUTED is an ALWAYS-REFUTE-ARTIFACT->VOID/uninterpretable.' classifyCalibration encodes this rule and returns ONE of FOUR terminal labels: SATURATED-VOID / ALWAYS-REFUTE-ARTIFACT-VOID / BELOW-CEILING-PROCEED / ARTIFACT-VOID-REDO. The min-not-met leg of (ii) is DERIVED MECHANICALLY by classifyCalibration from the pooled trace stop_reason over upheld claims (W-3); ONLY the truncated/quota-killed leg is human-inspection. classifyCalibration WRAPS calibratorGate byte-identical -- it never edits it.
stage1_pre_registration.cp_n_gate_statistic: RE-PLAN-5 (UNANIMOUS-3). The gate statistic is CP(0, N_claims) two-sided upper bound on the POOLED per-claim rate (matches the frozen engine -- calibratorGate.trials = N pooled claims; every CP value is a LABEL, never a clustered CI). Do NOT report CP over N*k as if independent (the k votes share one packet/claim/prompt -- positively correlated); per-vote 0/(N*k) is a LABELED SECONDARY diagnostic only. Report the PER-CLASS breakdown (~one per attack-mode, ~equal split of N_retained) so a globally-clean pooled rate cannot mask a single weak class. READ THE FULL retained N (RELIABLE_TRIALS=15 is a reportability FLOOR, not a stopping target; CP(0,60)~=0.05 vs CP(0,15)~=0.218 -- a ~4.6x tighter ceiling for free; a sub-full cap is a pure validity loss). FREEZE N_retained (the post-consensus denominator) the instant the consensus probe finishes, before vote 1; the run artifact records a partition checksum calibratorGate.trials(traps) + nControls == frozen N_retained(total) (W-2). Audit the min-not-met trace on every uphold (board guardrail 4).
stage1_pre_registration.absolute_per_model_design: RE-PLAN-7 (the PIVOT, board-converged; re-registered in the ZERO-VOTES window before any vote). The offline READ is PIVOTED from a RELATIVE Haiku-MINUS-Sonnet delta (Sonnet assumed-good baseline) to an ABSOLUTE PER-MODEL verdict: prove, for BOTH Haiku 4.5 AND Sonnet 4.6 (AND Opus 4.6 as the measured REFERENCE), WHETHER each WORKS as the lz-deep-research verify-voter. Sonnet is a SUBJECT on trial, NOT the yardstick. Per model M, voter role, TWO estimands pooled PER-CLAIM (denominator N_claims, NEVER N*k -- the k=9 votes share one packet, positively correlated): ESTIMAND A = FALSE-UPHOLD rate over the retained refuted-gold traps, statistic clopperPearsonUpperOneSided(x_FU, N_trap) (ONE-SIDED 95% upper, F2), PASS_A iff CP1s <= TAU_FU (0.10); ESTIMAND B = OVER-REFUSAL rate over the gold=unrefuted positive controls (the F1 always-refute detector), CP1s(x_OR, N_ctrl), PASS_B iff CP1s <= TAU_OR (0.15). VERDICT(M) = WORKS iff PASS_A AND PASS_B; DOES-NOT-WORK if either CI exceeds its TAU; VOID-on-power if N below its floor; VOID-artifact on an always-refute / min-not-met-trace collapse; VOID-difficulty / VOID-covariate from the F5 floors. SATURATION-as-PASS: a clean EARNED 0 on a hard, covariate-matched set with the controls upheld + the CI tight certifies WORKS (the RE-PLAN-5 SATURATED-VOID framing is RETIRED). certifyModel + decisionMatrix encode this in eval/lz-eval-offline-read.mjs (Task 2); the EVAL_THRESHOLDS existing numbers are byte-unchanged (only TAU_FU/TAU_OR + N_TRAP_FLOOR/N_CTRL_FLOOR are ADDED).
stage1_pre_registration.ci_convention: one-sided 95% upper (F2): clopperPearsonUpperOneSided(x,n) = jStat.beta.inv(1 - alpha, x+1, n-x), alpha=0.05 (the 0.95 quantile, a one-directional ceiling) -- the convention the ABSOLUTE per-model gate reads. The two-sided clopperPearsonUpper (1 - alpha/2) stays the recorded run-artifact LABEL for the carried relative read. Verified against the actual engine: CP1s(0,36)=0.0798 <= TAU_FU (the 0-miss N_trap floor 36); CP1s(1,46)=0.0990 <= TAU_FU (a 1-miss arm needs N_trap >= 46); CP1s(0,24)=0.1173 <= TAU_OR (the F1-corrected N_ctrl floor 24); CP1s(0,18)=0.1533 > TAU_OR (the OLD floor 18 mathematically FAILS, F1). The TAU/floor brackets are recomputed against this one-sided convention; NEVER relax a TAU to fit a realized N.
stage1_pre_registration.decision_matrix: RE-PLAN-7 (the four Opus-voter nuances). decisionMatrix({haiku, sonnet, opus}) -> the SHIP cell is the Haiku x Sonnet cross-product ONLY (nuance i -- Opus is NOT a ship cell): both / only-sonnet / only-haiku / neither, with a subject VOID surfaced explicitly. opusReference = { verdict, opusFailsBar } (nuance ii -- Opus is the reference ROW; opusFailsBar = opus.verdict !== WORKS is a NEW first-class MAJOR finding: the quality anchor the plugin leans on is below its own gate -> the near-Opus thesis is in question -> RAISE TO USER). nearOpusDiagnostic is CONDITIONAL on Opus clearing the bar (nuance iii -- suppressed/flagged not-meaningful when Opus does NOT work; tracking a wrong model is not reassurance). Opus-voter at k=9 is the priciest Claude-pool tier (nuance iv -- paced). framing is always 'clears-the-closed-book-SCREEN' (F4 -- never 'production-safe'); raiseToUser is always true (settle-OR-raise; a both-WORKS cell still does NOT auto-flip Haiku ON -- the Phase-20 live shadow is the named precondition).
stage1_pre_registration.out_of_family_only_retain: RE-PLAN-7 #3/F3 (Opus DROPPED from the gold-DECIDER, ADDED as a measured voter). The assembler RETAIN predicate is the OUT-OF-FAMILY all-probes-agree consensus (GPT-5.5 + Gemini) ONLY -- the in-family Opus probe is recorded as a NON-GATING annotation per packet (the OOF-vs-in-family agreement count is a diagnostic, never a gate). The gold is INDEPENDENT of the family on trial (it cannot grade Claude on a curve drawn by Claude). F3 framing correction: under all-agree AND, dropping the in-family conjunct LOOSENS the AND -> retains MORE -> higher N + purer (family-independent) gold (the 'drop Opus = lower N' framing was backwards). Opus is ADDED as a THIRD MEASURED VOTER on the same OUT-OF-FAMILY-screened gold (a clean cross-family measurement -- tested, not testing -- so it does NOT reintroduce the gold-curation bias #3 removed); it VALIDATES the quality anchor + yields the near-Opus diagnostic.
stage1_pre_registration.subject_difficulty_floor: RE-PLAN-7 F5 (NET-NEW). A held-out Claude reference verifier (subjectDifficultyProbe) is run over the RETAINED refuted-trap set; if its catch-rate exceeds a pre-registered max (subjectDifficultyMaxCatchRate) the retained set is too easy for the subject family to certify capability -> a documented VOID-difficulty (NOT a silent pass). The prior difficulty floor was calibrated against the weak-verifier + OOF axis only; this ADDS the subject-family axis. The floor is load-bearing, never tuned toward a desired N.
stage1_pre_registration.covariate_overlap_check: RE-PLAN-7 F5 (NET-NEW). The trap-arm vs control-arm distributions (claim length / survivor count / token-complexity) must OVERLAP within a pre-registered covariateOverlapTolerance, so a model cannot pass by STYLE (systematically longer/more-complex traps) rather than judgment. Below tolerance -> a documented VOID-covariate. certifyModel requires covariateOverlapMet (and difficultyFloorMet) for WORKS.
stage1_pre_registration.cluster_independence: RE-PLAN-7 F6 (NET-NEW). One PRIMARY claim per source/seed cluster is retained (or the cluster fails as a unit), so the per-claim CP denominator is not anti-conservative -- the k=9 votes share one packet (positively correlated) and same-cluster sub-claims are also correlated. For WiCE the cluster is the dev<NNNNN> source id (one Wikipedia claim, several sub-claims); for AVeriTeC the cluster is the source fact-check URL. reducePooledVerdict applies any-uphold SYMMETRICALLY on both arms (any-seat-false-uphold on a trap = fail; any-seat-refute on a control = the over-refusal event).
stage1_pre_registration.evidence_absent_stratum_floor: RE-PLAN-7 F7 (NET-NEW). The evidence-absent sub-construct has its own pre-registered per-stratum minimum (certifyModel requires evidenceAbsentStratumMet === true for WORKS; an unmet stratum is VOID-on-power scoped to evidence-absent, NOT a silent WORKS over a sub-construct WiCE cannot supply). The WiCE-heavy trap BULK does NOT launder WiCE power into an evidence-absent claim: WiCE carries the trap BULK (closed-book-native) while the AVeriTeC arm supplies the SEPARATE evidence-absent trap stratum + native controls. If the evidence-absent stratum floor cannot be met offline it is explicitly DEFERRED to Phase-20 by name.

per_model_prompt_shas.note: RE-PLAN-7 #2/F8 (PER-MODEL FAIR PROMPTS, not a shared prompt). Each per-model voter prompt is FROZEN + sha256'd here in the zero-votes window; the dispatch records the selected model + the frozen prompt-sha per seat, and the anti-drift test asserts each recorded sha matches the agent file. A per-model verdict is 'works UNDER ITS OWN BEST PROMPT' (the deployment-realistic question; the principled resolution of ATTACK-7). The Opus prompt is best-effort-engineered, NOT a verbatim Sonnet copy (a thin mirror would under-test Opus and corrupt the reference anchor, W4).

stage1_pre_registration.wice_closed_book_trap_arm: RE-PLAN-7 W1/F7 (NET-NEW). The WiCE CLOSED-BOOK trap+control arm (eval/lz-eval-wice-traps.mjs, assembleWiceTraps) carries the trap BULK -- it is closed-book-NATIVE and CANNOT run the AVeriTeC dateFilter / >=5-survivor / staticKsAdapter pipeline (WiCE has no dated-URL KS; book:'closed'). It REUSES the committed Phase-18 vendored WiCE data (eval/__fixtures__/wice-vendored/records) + loader (remapLabel: supported->unrefuted / partially_supported|not_supported->refuted). A WiCE TRAP = { claim + its GIVEN closed-book evidence + the human partially_supported|not_supported label -> gold=refuted }; a WiCE CONTROL = { supported -> gold=unrefuted }.
